context_files.role: Path attributes mount boundary/cluster/line/span and reexport public DTO/map names.

Direct consumer of both DTOs and cfg(test) mount of line perf; current versus previous boundary maps to fixed affinity, source spans merge adjacent visual ranges, lazy cache/linear oracle remain parent-private.
Parent cfg(test) mount gives cluster perf access to optimized and linear projection helpers.
Context-only LTR/RTL boundary, discontiguous selection, combining/fallback examples; not R086 formal test coverage.
Decoration generation consumes projected visual_range through the same line map.
Actual Runtime hit-test selects current/previous cluster side; source-map fallback is used only when artifact/source caret is absent.
UiTextRange is an owning pair of UTF-8 byte offsets; DTO fields alone do not validate source data.

coverage_basis: All 411 original physical lines read manually. Explicit declaration/member and gapfree semantic block decisions, checked against real source names. Name anchors are mechanical crosschecks, not AST or global caller completeness. Context reads are not source coverage.

traits.evidence: Two complete DTO leaves have builtin derive attributes. Test leaves declare no impl/trait. UiTextRange's own Serialize/Deserialize derives (C7:15-19) do not derive serde for UiTextVisualSpan.

macros.scope: Complete four-file lexical/source review, not expansion output or a claim that derive generation is absent.

registration.evidence: Only two plain DTO declarations and test fixtures/harness functions. Direct mounts C2/C3 are cfg(test) Rust modules, C1/C8/C9 are static module/reexport paths. No runtime registry operation is declared here.

ffi.evidence: Complete source leaves contain no pointer/ABI boundary; downstream integration beyond the recorded Rust consumers is not claimed exhaustive.

lifecycle.dto: Copy offsets/enum values retain no document reference and do not keep runtime text alive. Struct literals do not perform ordering or UTF-8 checks.
lifecycle.fixtures: Fixtures own String/Vec data; local maps borrow their fixture during each test/benchmark. Construction is outside timed loops; this does not measure font loading or real shaping.

tests.limits: Fixed ASCII LTR fixtures and comparisons to parent linear oracles; not general Unicode/bidi/concurrent-cache coverage. No build mode is enforced by #[ignore] or test name. Eleven sorted samples use the last observed sample, not a promised statistical percentile.

cross_cutting.search_limits: Candidate and caller searches covered interface/src, runtime/src and editor/src. Real consumed paths and parent helper bodies were read; lexical search is not AST resolution or proof of all indirect callers.
